description_en: Extends or shortens the invisibility period of a message that is in the Inactive state
description_zh: 用于延长或缩短处于 Inactive 状态的消息的不可见时间
name: ChangeMessageVisibility

parameters.help_en: The temporary handle of the message returned after the last consumption
parameters.help_zh: 上次消费后返回的消息临时句柄
parameters.name: receipt_handle

parameters.help_en: The countdown from the current moment until the message becomes Active again. Valid values: 1 to 43200. Unit: seconds (1 second to 12 hours)
parameters.help_zh: 从当前时刻开始，消息重新变为 Active 的倒计时。[1, 43200]（秒），即 1 秒 ~ 12 小时
parameters.name: visibility_timeout

schema.description_en: The response includes the new temporary handle and the time when the message can be consumed again (millisecond-level timestamp)
schema.description_zh: 返回参数包括新的临时句柄和下次可被再次消费的时间（毫秒时间戳）

NextVisibleTime.description_en: The time when the message can be consumed again (millisecond-level timestamp)
NextVisibleTime.description_zh: 下次可被再次消费的时间（毫秒时间戳）

ReceiptHandle.description_en: The new temporary handle. Use this new handle for subsequent delete or modification operations. This handle is valid before NextVisibleTime
ReceiptHandle.description_zh: 新的临时句柄（后续删除/修改操作必须使用此新句柄），NextVisibleTime 之前有效

v1_parameters.help_en: The temporary handle of the message returned after the last consumption
v1_parameters.help_zh: 上次消费后返回的消息临时句柄
v1_parameters.name: receiptHandle

v1_parameters.help_en: The countdown from the current moment until the message becomes Active again. Valid values: 1 to 43200. Unit: seconds (1 second to 12 hours)
v1_parameters.help_zh: 从当前时刻开始，消息重新变为 Active 的倒计时。[1, 43200]（秒），即 1 秒 ~ 12 小时
v1_parameters.name: visibilityTimeout
